Role Purpose:

To manage, secure, and optimize the organization’s database environments while providing reliable regional IT support across multiple sites, ensuring high availability, performance, data integrity, and secure access to business-critical systems and applications in alignment with business continuity and operational objectives

Job Accountabilities:

• Database Administration:

Install, configure, monitor, maintain, and optimize enterprise databases to ensure performance, availability, and reliability.

• Database Performance &

• Optimization:

Perform performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, and capacity planning to maintain optimal database performance.

• Backup &

• Recovery:

Manage database backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery processes to ensure data resilience and business continuity.

• Database Security &

• Access Control:

Implement database security controls, user access management, encryption, and audit logging to protect sensitive data.

• High Availability &

• Disaster Recovery:

Support database clustering, failover, replication, and DR solutions to minimize downtime and data loss.

• Regional IT Support:

Provide technical support to regional sites for infrastructure, endpoints, applications, and user issues as required.

• Application &

• ERP Support:

Support business-critical applications and databases including platforms such as SAP S/4HANA and other enterprise systems.

• Server &

• Infrastructure Support:

Assist with server administration, storage, virtualization, and cloud environments supporting database workloads.

• Monitoring &

• Incident Management:

Proactively monitor database health, resolve incidents, and perform root cause analysis for recurring issues.

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology., with Computer Science or Information Technology as major.

• Accredited Certifications such as Microsoft Certified Database Administrator, Azure Administrator, Microsoft Certified Windows Server & other relevant technical certifications are mandated.

• 2–5 years experience in database administration and enterprise IT support.

jobs.job_title: Database Administrator: SQL & MongoDB Performance Lead
jobs.job_description:
Mutakamela Insurance is seeking a Database Administrator to manage, optimize, and secure our database systems. The role requires extensive SQL Database Administration experience (including monitoring, backups, and performance tuning) and MongoDB expertise where possible.

The candidate will ensure reliability, integrity, and availability of database systems, implement efficient backup and recovery strategies, and monitor performance to support operations across platforms.

Job Description:

Technology Management

Database Expertise
Possesses in-depth knowledge of multiple database technologies, including:

Oracle Technologies
Expert-level understanding of Oracle database administration, including:
• Performance tuning (e.g., SQL optimization, indexing strategies)
• Security best practices (e.g., Oracle Data Redaction, user privilege management, database auditing)
• High availability and disaster recovery (e.g., Data Guard configuration, failover testing)
• Backup and recovery (e.g., RMAN backups, point-in-time recovery)
• User and access control management (RBAC)
• Advanced features (e.g., partitioning, materialized views)

Exadata Operations
Strong understanding of Exadata architecture, including:
• Storage management (e.g., Storage Cell configuration, Intelligent Storage Pool)
• Performance optimization (e.g., In-Memory technology, InfiniBand networking)
• Integration with Oracle database features for optimal performance

Microsoft SQL Server
Expert-level understanding of SQL Server administration, including:
• Performance optimization (e.g., query tuning, indexing strategies)
• Security best practices (e.g., Always Encrypted, data masking, role-based security)
• High availability and disaster recovery (e.g., Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering)
• Backup and recovery (e.g., transaction log backups, point-in-time recovery)
• User and access control management
• Advanced features (e.g., partitioning, replication)

MySQL Databases
Expert-level understanding of MySQL administration, including:
• Performance optimization (e.g., query optimization, buffer pool management)
• Security best practices (e.g., user privileges, encryption in transit and at rest)
• Replication configurations (e.g., master-slave, multi-master replication)
• Backup and recovery (e.g., mysqldump, binary backups)
• Advanced features (e.g., partitioning, stored procedures)

Additional Capabilities
• Stays up to date with industry trends, emerging database technologies, and security best practices
• Designs and implements solutions to optimize performance, scalability, security, and resource utilization, including:
• Capacity planning and resource allocation
• Performance tuning and bottleneck resolution
• High availability and disaster recovery implementation
• Database security design and enforcement

Database Design & Security
• Leads the design and implementation of secure database configurations across Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, and Sybase environments
• Defines and enforces security policies (access control, encryption, auditing)
• Implements advanced database security features

Operational Excellence
• Develops complex scripts to automate database administration tasks and improve efficiency
• Monitors database health, performance, and availability using advanced tools
• Troubleshoots complex issues (e.g., performance degradation, data corruption) and identifies root causes
Governance (Risk, Policy & Processes)
• Adheres to established database administration policies, security standards, and operational procedures
• Identifies and assesses database-related risks and recommends mitigation strategies
• Contributes to the development of governance frameworks in collaboration with the Database Manager
Change Management
• Participates in planning and executing database changes in line with change management procedures (e.g., change windows, rollback plans)
• Provides technical support to ensure clear communication of changes and impacts to stakeholders
• Supports development and testing of database change scripts
• Assists in implementing rollback procedures when required

Requirements:
7+ years of experience in Oracle DBA roles
Strong experience in OCI, Exadata, RAC, Data Guard, and GoldenGate
Experience in database migration and performance tuning

Role: Cloud Database Administrator (DBA)

Location: Riyadh, KSA

My client is a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider.

The role

Seeking a Cloud Database Administrator (DBA) to join our high-impact infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the mission-critical cloud-native database environments.

From relational to NoSQL systems, you will ensure our databases are highly available, secure, scalable, and optimized for performance to support millions of transactions daily.

Your work will directly impact the reliability of the services, helping to deliver seamless experiences to customers while meeting the demands of a rapidly growing global SaaS platform.

What Will You Do

Design, deploy, and maintain highly available cloud-hosted databases (AWS RDS, Aurora, Oracle OCI DB services, DocumentDB, Redis).

Implement robust backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity.

Proactively monitor database performance, tune queries, and optimize indexing and partitioning strategies.

Automate routine DBA tasks using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).

Collaborate closely with SRE and DevOps teams to embed database reliability into CI/CD pipelines.

Ensure data security and compliance with industry standards (encryption, access control, auditing).

Troubleshoot and resolve complex database incidents, including replication lag, connection bottlenecks, and performance degradation.

Document database architecture, operational runbooks, and best practices for cross-team use.

Evaluate emerging database technologies and propose adoption strategies to enhance scalability and efficiency.
• ** We need people that have actually built platforms, at scale and with enterprise level of data/transactions (circa millions of records plus). The ideal candidate will have worked in a high growth scale up. A key project will be dividing there single massive database into multiple smaller databases to facilitate a microservices infrastructure ***
